title: Casper and the Bell
author: Dominic Yarrow
blurb: Oscar Villalobos, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
